ba_ba_ba_batman: Casimir "Button" Batman reached R-F7 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Casimir "Button" Batman read a letter that said the neighbour had married again. The whole dugout wanted the missing first half of the story. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Casimir "Button" Batman watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Casimir "Button" Batman changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Norbert Slc lent Casimir "Button" Batman a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Casimir "Button" Batman borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
calderthebald: Benedikt Calderthebal arrived on Day 4 as a replacement. The men in R-F5 had been fighting for 3 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Benedikt Calderthebal and Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Calderthebal. Benedikt Calderthebal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Benedikt Calderthebal raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F5. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp of the Concord (@gavinlordofpugs).
calin._av: On Day 5 Arno "Rabbit" Calin took a post at R-F23 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He sleeps with his boots on, and the men liked him for it.
A bullet found Arno "Rabbit" Calin at R-F23, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Arno "Smokes" Den of the Concord (@ay.den0707).
coopergfulton: Arno Coopergfulto came up on Day 5 carrying news from Millbank. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Arno Coopergfulto fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
